I am 32 years old.

My ex-wife and I have a daughter together, and we adopted our son together. Both are now 4 years old.

When we were going through our separation, I felt lost and unhappy. I was self-destructive. One day, I was so angry with everything spiraling out of control that I punched a concrete wall in a moment of overwhelming emotion. This resulted in breaking my fifth metacarpal in my right hand—the hand I worked with, played games with, and used to carry my children to bed—the hand I desperately needed to ensure I could continue providing.

Upon learning the severity of the self-inflicted damage, I became almost suicidal. Keep in mind that just a few months before this, I was the happiest man, with no history of depression or anxiety. I had never experienced anger outbursts, nor was I the type to break down and cry, but I was in a tough situation that truly prevented me from seeing the light on the other side.

With nothing better to do, I looked for a game I could play WITH ONE HAND while recovering. Somehow, I stumbled upon this game and read some of the comments. I decided it was worth a try... I must admit I didn't beat the game, nor did I play as much as some of you. In fact, I may have played this game for only a day or two. That being said, after doing so, I had a new joy and hope for life. I managed to leave behind the pain and suffering that had been thrust upon me. I could experience the joy and happiness of other people. I relaxed for 5 ♥♥♥♥ minutes listening to this music, long enough to realize that I would be okay.

After realizing this, I turned off the game and went back to work. My hand hurt a lot, but I was motivated. I stopped feeling so sorry for myself and became the father I needed to be at that moment, not the weak boy I was behaving like.

Today, I am close friends with the mother of my children. We don't fight, argue, or say hurtful things to each other. We are parents and friends.

Now I have 3 children. My third child is, wait, ALSO 4 YEARS OLD. The woman I am with was going through a very similar situation at the time of my separation, and we just unexpectedly stumbled into each other's lives. We have been dating for a year and are very happy together.

Moral of the story: you never know what life has in store for you, and if I had given up when all odds were against me, I wouldn't be where I am today. This silly little game helped me realize that.

Thank you.

Fun enough slaughterfest to warrant getting all the achievements.  Recommend playing enough to get a little gold on hand and then moving to the slot machine to earn piles of gold, and unlock characters and weapons.  You can unlock pets and hats with slots also, but pets have limited use (not to mention you outrun them the whole game so if you want them to be useful you have to run back to them a lot) and hats are kinda meh since most characters already have a hat that fits them well.

To play you select a character, pick a single weapon upgrade they can take with them, pick a pet, upgrade stats, and then head out.  Weapons all have a cost once you are in a match, so picking a high priced gun you like at the start can make your play easier and more fun.  I tend to use the pistol slot the most since you have unlimited ammo, and there are a lot to pick from that are way better than the default one.  Note that any stats you upgrade at character select are permanent upgrades, while any stats you get with skill points while playing are lost upon death, while luck is the only stat not upgradable with gold.

If you want the best character you can get to grind out achievements I would recommend playing slots to unlock a 3-luck character (I used classics like The Godfather, Lucifer, and Agent 48), grind some gold with slots to max their stat upgrades, grind some weapons with slots until you get a high quality pistol slot weapon you like (throwing stars are pretty insane) to equip, take a gun (shoots) or butterfly drone (mana regen) to increase your DPS, and then go wipe as many stages as you care to.  To finish the achievements you'll likely have to launch a bunch of matches to just sit there and die, spend a bunch of gold during the match to buy cheeseburgers, and leave the game running overnight once while you sleep to get the 12 hours in.  Have fun!

一款内容还算比较丰富的二维动作射击游戏，整个游戏分为四大模式：
1.adventure，游戏主要的玩法之一，俯视角的防守生存类游戏，初始选择角色后开始防御敌从四周出现的敌人
击杀敌人掉落金币、武器、以及各种用来升级武器的强化道具
2.dungeon，同adventure的基本内容一致，只不过场景换到了一个可以不停往下探索的地下城中
在这里除了敌人以外还有很多陷阱以及可以打破获得奖励的宝箱
3.arcade，游戏模式上发生了非常大的变化，不再是之前的俯视角，改为了横版
玩法上则是在一关关之间移动，消灭路上从前后方出现的各种僵尸，同样会掉落武器、金币这些
4.deathmatch，类似于PVP死斗模式，在一块有限的场景里4人互相厮杀
不过单人下仍然有PC参战，但可玩性的话单人算是没有前3个高

游戏的前3个模式下大致有几类武器可以使用：手枪、冲锋枪、突击步枪、霰弹枪、榴弹类武器等
除了手枪是无限子弹的，其他所有武器都有一定的弹药限制，可以通过拾取怪物掉落的进行补充，或者在商店里通过花钱购买
另外前两种模式掉落的强化道具则可以安放在武器上以此获得不同凡的效果（比如穿透、增大子弹体积、增快射速等等）
